name: mailman
description: Self-hosted, team-shared API client. Postman without the bill.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,desktop -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run pack -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke -w desktop
